DISCHARGE: the generator naming every undefined reference of the members a bound symbol pulls (transitively inside the archive), and either pinning the files that define them or stating them as named premises.

registered.title: A manifest header without a `struct!` is digested, not read
registered.why: Found by W48-QRLIB-LINKAGE. On the FFI route a manifest header is compared with the `struct!` read (by digest) for every struct a callee carries; a header bound for scalar-only callees (e.g. `math.h`) is only digested, and the emitted C declares each callee from its contract, so a mismatching declaration is caught only where the compiler knows a builtin's signature. The bounded header reader of §G02d.2 cannot read a system header. Size M. DISCHARGE: the generator reading each bound function's declaration from the header with the recorded compiler's typed AST (the `ffi_layout` transport) and refusing one the contract's C signature disagrees with.

registered.title: Artifact shapes the symbol readers refuse unread
registered.why: Found by W48-QRLIB-LINKAGE (specification §L14.8, limitation 9). Refused by name rather than read: ELF shared objects without section headers (read through `PT_DYNAMIC` instead), universal (fat) Mach-O files and archives, COFF `/bigobj` and link-time-code-generation (anonymous) objects, thin archives, LLVM bitcode archive members, and `ld` scripts nested more than one level. Each refuses generation, so no manifest states less than it read. Size M. DISCHARGE: each shape read with a fixture and a unit test, or kept refused with its reason recorded per shape.

An import naming an API-set DLL (`api-ms-win-*`) is checked against the file of that name as read, and the loader's redirection to a host DLL is part of the runtime premise. The card's Windows row imports from `ntdll.dll`, which is not an API set. Size S. registered.title: C `long` has no manifest or §G02t spelling, so `lrint`-like functions are not callable
registered.why: Found by W48-QRLIB-LINKAGE. `long` is 64 bits on LP64 and 32 on LLP64, and `int64_t` is `long` on Linux but `long long` on macOS, so declaring libm's `lrint`/`lround` as `int64_t` is an incompatible redeclaration there; the card's libm rows use `ilogb`, `sqrt`, `fabs`, `fmax`, `nextafter` and `floor` instead. Size S. DISCHARGE: a data-model-aware `long`/`unsigned long` spelling in the contract and manifest vocabularies, projected per recorded target, and `lrint` linked on Linux and macOS.

registered.title: `quirin check`/`emit` still select no extern contract environment
registered.why: Found by W48-QRLIB-LINKAGE. `quirin qrlib generate`, `quirin qrlib check` and `quirin build` take `--contracts`, but `quirin check` and `quirin emit` select none, so an FFI program that calls C is checked from the command line only by `quirin build` (or the library API) and refuses at `Q023` under `check`.
